response.sql: WITH lab_patients AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, l.ALB, CASE WHEN l.`T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` != 0 AND l.UN IS NOT NULL THEN l.UN / CAST(l.`T-BIL` AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END as un_tbil_ratio FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(ALB) as avg_alb, AVG(un_tbil_ratio) as avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM lab_patients GROUP BY ID, SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) as sex_avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) as sex_avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb) as mean_alb FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.sex_avg_alb, s.sex_avg_un_tbil_ratio, s.sex_avg_alb - om.mean_alb as alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages s CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE s.sex_avg_alb > om.mean_alb ORDER BY s.SEX
